issues.finding: The displayed set for V_infty permits m=0 while its members contain n/m; the following V_5 example uses zero among the natural numerators, so zero cannot simply be excluded from Nat by convention. The denominator must be positive.
issues.proposed_resolution: Add 0<m to the rational set-builder conditions while retaining 0<=n<=m and the interval [0,1].

issues.location: finite rational grid upper bound and index range
issues.finding: For V_m, the displayed condition n<=m includes n=m and therefore a value m/(m-1)>1 when m>1; it also leaves m=1 with a zero denominator. The immediately following V_5 example has exactly five values n/(5-1) for n=0,...,4.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use n<m in the set-builder condition and state in the surrounding prose that the index is at least two.

translation_treatment: The target translates rational and real infinite truth-value sets, finite grids, designated 1 and fuzzy terminology while correcting the two denominator and indexing bounds. The frozen source remains unchanged.
